role: Code-signing entitlements of the iOS app target.
toplevel: Grants HealthKit, HealthKit background delivery, App Group group.com.chrissharp.flowrecovery (used by AppConfig.appGroupIdentifier, Emuqu/Sources/Utilities/Constants.swift:9, for archive/raw-RR/crash/breadcrumb/feedback containers and the UnitsPreference suite), and iCloud CloudKit container iCloud.com.chrissharp.flowrecovery (Constants.swift:12). Comment (lines 3-11) says both identifiers predate the Emuqu rename and must never change because they address live user data: the App Group container holds the app's session archive, raw RR backups and saved routes, and the CloudKit container holds every synced session. No aps-environment (no push / CloudKit subscriptions; grep finds no CKSubscription or registerForRemoteNotifications), no ubiquity-kvstore-identifier (EntitlementAnchor.swift:20-24 deliberately uses Keychain instead of NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore), no keychain-access-groups.
